name: Osagiri Shuka
source:
The protagonist of the game. He's working as a bartender and also as a representative owner at bar "69". Had a going-with-the-flow attitude about things, especially relationships.

[spoiler]He's in love with his half-sister Futaai. Because of this, he's been haunted by dreams and guilt toward his feeling. Also, seemed to have special power but nothing really got explained.[/spoiler]
